question: Can a frozen universal sparse unifilar probability law losslessly recode selected POLARIS/STRATA arithmetic decisions by at least 0.15288996696291447 physical bits per source weight while leaving reconstruction unchanged?

scope.included: selected binary SC decisions, their decoder-regenerated Q0.16 base probability bucket, polar level, four-phase coordinate, causal unifilar state, and exact current arithmetic payload
excluded: source-coordinate quantizer-label copula before selected SC decisions
unselected quantizer labels or analog source weights
MERA, TTN, RCC, Gray-Wyner, flow, fibre, or LDGM claims
model provenance, ancestors, router activations, or checkpoint-specific decoder side information
scope.negative_result_boundary: closes only this frozen finite topology/state/reset/search rule; it is not a converse for arbitrary MPS or source-coordinate copulas

topologies.xor_sketch: if y=1, s' = s XOR nonzero_mix(public_context,t)&(chi-1); otherwise s'=s
topologies.rolling_affine: s' = (a*s + mix(public_context,t) + y) mod chi, with frozen odd a

candidate_bank.runtime: each cell performs one integer transition and one table lookup per selected symbol; the frozen 150-cell bank is O(150*N)=O(N), never O(N*chi^2)

causal_probability_and_reset.fit: exact integer counts with Jeffreys one-half count per binary outcome, then deterministic integer nearest rounding and clamp to [1,65535]
causal_probability_and_reset.t0_law: before symbol position zero and every position divisible by reset_length, set state=0; look up frequency at state=0 and t=0; arithmetic-code y; only then apply the exact symbol-conditioned transition
causal_probability_and_reset.stream_boundary: every canonical arithmetic stream starts a fresh state=0 and t=0

input_contract.weight_charge_rule: stream charges are positive integers and sum exactly to panel source weights
input_contract.baseline_replay: before CuPy import, canonical CPU arithmetic encoding must reproduce every current logical bit length and every current payload byte

nested_scientific_holdout.outer_development: exclude every stream sharing the outer layer OR outer expert
nested_scientific_holdout.inner_validation: sort outer-development streams by a frozen SHA-256 partition digest; take max(1,floor(n/5)) and never more than n-1 as validation
nested_scientific_holdout.selection: fit all 150 cells on inner train; select minimum exact byte-padded validation arithmetic bits plus one literal model packet; ties by selector ordinal
nested_scientific_holdout.outer_score: refit selected cell on all outer development and exact-arithmetic-code the untouched outer test
nested_scientific_holdout.restriction: no full-panel or outer-test selection is used for the heldout claim
nested_scientific_holdout.physical_interpretation: fold replicas are scientific evidence only; their separately charged models are not represented as one deployable packet

final_physical_packet.topology_selection: majority of nested outer-fold selections, ties by selector ordinal, fixed before full-panel parameter fitting
final_physical_packet.parameter_fit: fit only Q0.16 table values on the full source panel and serialize them literally
final_physical_packet.output: one model packet and one concatenation of canonical terminated arithmetic payloads; every stream is decoded and canonically re-encoded before acceptance
final_physical_packet.ledger: charge global header, literal model and selector, directory, immutable global/local decoder state, expert headers, arithmetic termination, final-byte padding, page alignment, and any rate-floor padding
final_physical_packet.hard_kill_evidence: only exact canonical arithmetic bytes and the literal physical ledger; continuous NLL is never a hard-kill bound
final_physical_packet.pass: F<=0.8 at a literal 2.15..2.5 bpw and cold read <2x

gaussian_controls.opening_gate: source final physical packet and pooled nested heldout score must both meet the standalone threshold
gaussian_controls.baseline_order: load, authenticate, and independently replay all eight current Gaussian arithmetic baselines before fitting any control model
gaussian_controls.candidate: source-selected topology/state/reset only; fitted Q0.16 tables are independently refit and charged for each control
gaussian_controls.specificity_rule: source final exact physical saving must exceed every one of eight independently replayed/refit controls

status_lattice.HARD_KILL_EXACT_PHYSICAL_SOURCE_PACKET: one final physical packet misses the absolute target; controls cannot repair it
status_lattice.NO_PROMOTION_NESTED_HELDOUT_THRESHOLD_FA: physical source fit survives but untouched nested folds do not
status_lattice.NO_PROMOTION_GAUSSIAN_SPECIFICITY_FAIL: physical and heldout source gates survive but the source does not beat every matched Gaussian control
status_lattice.PROMOTE_FINITE_UNIVERSAL_CELL: physical, sealed nested holdout, and Gaussian specificity all pass

implementation.cpu_reference: portable standard-library exact transition, fitting, model packet, arithmetic encoder, arithmetic decoder, and canonical re-encode verification
implementation.gpu: CuPy RawKernel only; uint64 exact counts and exact 32-bit arithmetic logical-length replay; runtime synthetic CPU/GPU equality preflight
implementation.source_free_fixture: cumulative-prefix-parity law proves a chi=2 XOR cell can beat every suffix depth 1..6 under exact heldout arithmetic coding

lifecycle.wrong_token: reject before output reservation, input access, project import, CuPy import, or CUDA
lifecycle.valid_token: reserve an absent output directory first; externally authenticate the independent review receipt and source manifest; verify every declared source member; only then import project code
lifecycle.numeric_import: hold/authenticate/replay the source panel before importing CuPy
lifecycle.symlink_policy: reject the unresolved leaf with lstat before open; also use O_NOFOLLOW and hold regular-file descriptors
lifecycle.completion: COMPLETE.json is created exclusively last; incomplete directories are never resumed

universality.algorithm: one frozen topology/fitting/search/split/seed/control rule for arbitrary canonical SwiGLU-MoE SC decision streams
universality.checkpoint_adaptation: only fitted Q0.16 values serialized in the literal model packet
universality.qwen_role: evaluation panel only, never a decoder key or architectural dependency
